h: Falling on the Face in Humility and Self Sacrifice

p: וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם וְגוֹמֵר (בְּמִדְבַּר טז, כב)
"'And they fell upon their faces, etc.' (Bamidbar 16:22):
gave themselves over to death, etc.;
"To You, Hashem, I lift up my soul, etc."
"From where do I have meat, etc.";
since this was not of his level,
for he is from the side of the Tree of Life,
it is stated in the holy Zohar
rather, to the place where death
and this is the Tree of Death, etc."
And he said, "And let me not see my evil":
when it was said to them (Bamidbar 16:21):
"Separate yourselves from amid the congregation, etc.,"
that we are not better than they;
for the generation of the wilderness
עַל פָּסוּק דַּרְדַּע (מְלָכִים א ה, יא)
for he was in the secret of Da'as.
of the generation of the wilderness
אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ (תְּהִלִּים קמד, טו)
"Fortunate is the people for whom it is so" (Tehillim 144:15):
"Let us appoint a leader and return, etc.,"
"And Moshe and Aharon fell upon their faces";
the whole generation of the wilderness,
surely we are not better than they;
and they gave themselves over to death,
and it was a fall from their levels;
and this is the meaning of "and they fell."
it is not written "Separate yourselves from amid the congregation,"
רַק הֵרֹמּוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה וְגוֹמֵר (שָׁם יז, י)
but "Rise up from amid the congregation, etc." (ibid. 17:10);
for you are not equal to the generation;
that he was from the side of the Tree of Life,
and as he said, "From where do I have meat,"
then what is it that he said,
also an aspect of the Feminine
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג קעח, ב)
"But the woman of the Tree of Life
'A woman of valor is her husband's crown';
'A woman of valor, who can find? etc.';
and this is the Shechinah, etc."
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
that he too was like Adam HaRishon
into Gan Eden to entice him;
and the Ramban, of blessed memory, wrote:
"And it does not say 'and they fell,'
for Aharon, in his discipline and holiness,
and was as one who keeps silent,
that they suspected him of a married woman,
'And they envied Moshe in the camp, etc.'"
But where is it alluded to here
that this is what he heard?
And what proof is there from Tehillim
that they suspected him of a married woman?
will in the end stumble with a married woman, etc."
"Even if he declared Hakadosh Baruch Hu
whose face was the face of the sun
and like Yaakov, who is called the sun,
like Adam HaRishon before the corruption,
who did not know at all
Yaakov is the aspect of the Body,
he should no longer have had to fear
that he too was from the side of the Feminine;
even though he is from the Tree of Life,
he is from the side of the Feminine
and just as the yetzer hara entered
אַף שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה לוֹ יֵצֶר הָרָע
even though he had no yetzer hara,
And when he heard that they said,
"And why do you exalt yourselves over the congregation of Hashem?"
that they suspected him of a married woman,
since he had haughtiness of spirit;
that it is a fall from one's levels:
only from the side of the Feminine,
שֶׁלֹּא יִגַּע בּוֹ גַּם כֵּן הָרַע
that evil would not touch him too,
"And let me not see my evil."
these pesukim had not yet been written,
and all the more so Moshe Rabbeinu,
in the way that we find
they would not have pursued David, etc.";
even though in the days of Doeg and Achitofel
there had not yet been written
they knew to arrive by their own understanding
that sin does not extinguish Torah.
And so Moshe Rabbeinu arrived at
will in the end stumble with a married woman."
"And why do you exalt yourselves, etc.,"
and suspected him of a married woman.
that he fell from his level,
that he still had to fear
that the yetzer hara would enter to entice him,
it does not say "and they fell upon their faces,"
but "and he fell upon his face."
